Hi John / Priya,

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation. Quick recap and next steps so we’re aligned: 

Summary of your requirements (from the call)
- Handling PHI under HIPAA for the patient-facing inference flows.
- Must sign a BAA and provide SOC 2 Type II evidence.
- Audit logs and retention policy for 1 year with exportable logs for audits.
- Encryption at rest (customer KMS preferred) and in transit.
- Preferred deployment: strong interest in Private VPC or on-prem due to regulatory controls; open to Dedicated if it meets isolation + BAA requirements and uses customer-managed KMS.

What I’m sharing now (attachments + links)
- SOC2_report_v3.pdf — our most recent SOC 2 Type II summary (redacted where appropriate).
- BAA_template.docx — draft BAA we can sign; we’ve executed BAA with similar customers.
- deployment-options-one-pager.pdf — quick comparison (Hosted API vs Dedicated vs Private VPC/on-prem).

Proposed next steps
1) Please confirm any gaps in the attached SOC 2 summary vs what your auditors need (e.g., full Type II report vs SOC bridge).
2) Review the BAA draft and flag edits — I can loop legal if needed.
3) Technical deep-dive: would you like a short call this week with our infra lead to walk deployment options, KMS integration, and audit/log exports? I’m available: Wed 10/7 10–12 PT or Thu 10/8 9–11 PT.

Cost note: I can provide a ballpark for Dedicated vs Private once we confirm throughput and average sequence lengths — I’ll follow up with engineering for a sizing estimate.

If helpful I can also open a HubSpot record and share a detailed mutual action plan.

Thanks — talk soon.

—
Marissa Cole

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap and the docs — appreciated. A few quick clarifying items from our side: 

1) SOC 2: Our security team needs the full SOC 2 Type II report (not just the summary) or SOC bridge + auditor confirmation. Can you indicate whether you can provide the complete Type II report under NDA / partial redaction?

2) BAA: We'll have legal review but initial read looks ok. Any changes to data residency or log retention in the template? We need explicit 12-month retention and export for audits.

3) Deployment mode: We prefer Private VPC or on-prem given PHI, but want to understand (a) whether Dedicated with customer-managed KMS satisfies BAA controls, (b) network egress/topology, and (c) what audit logs (and format) are available.

4) Timeline: Targeting a security review this month. Can you get SOC 2 and a short technical runbook before 10/16? Also please provide a high-level cost band (monthly) for Dedicated and Private options for a starting throughput of ~15 req/s and average 1k-token requests.

If you can get those items over, I’ll escalate to legal and security.

Best,

John — great questions. Short answers and what I’ll deliver by EOD 10/09: 

SOC 2: We can provide the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. I’ve looped in Legal and will get a copy to you via our secure share (or executed NDA flow) by 10/09.

BAA: The draft attached already reflects 12-month retention and audit export language. If Legal wants edits, we’ll coordinate directly.

Deployment options (high-level):
- Hosted API: simplest, but not suitable for PHI under your requirements. No BAA for PHI flows.
- Dedicated (reserved GPU pool): supports BAA and can be configured to use customer-managed KMS for encryption at rest. Provides network isolation and tenant isolation but runs in our managed infra; good fit when you want predictable latency + lower management overhead.
- Private VPC / On-prem: recommended for strict regulatory needs — private control plane, customer VPC peering or on-prem bundle, full control over KMS and network; we support audit/tracing hooks and longer log retention. This is the approach most customers handling PHI choose.

Audit logs & exports: we provide structured audit logs (json) with timestamps, request IDs, model versions, and basic request metadata. Exports available via secure S3 or direct transfer; retention configurable up to multi-year depending on plan.

Cost band (very rough) for ~15 req/s, 1k tokens avg: 
- Dedicated: estimate $25k–$40k / month (depends on commit and burst policy).
- Private VPC (managed control plane): estimate $40k–$80k / month (higher due to isolation + KMS + longer retention).

Next steps I’m taking: 
- Share full SOC 2 Type II under NDA by 10/09.
- Share a short technical runbook that shows KMS integration and audit log export format.
- Schedule a technical deep-dive with our infra lead — proposed Wed 10/07 10:30 PT (I have one slot) or Thu 10/08 9:30 PT. Which works for the security team?

If that timeline works I’ll also open a mutual action plan in HubSpot and get an engineering sizing ticket created.

—
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
